what_this_is: eval_gold was reviewed by a language model, not a human (verify.REVIEWERS). The `teacher` arm therefore measures model-vs-model agreement, and no arm in this project is scored against human-checked ground truth.
method: Targeted review. Three uniform mechanical passes were applied to all 330 candidates (posting_date nulled where the source text provably contains no date; 'unknown' removed from str|None fields; education_level 'none' -> 'unknown' where no education token appears). Documents carrying an F3 confidence hint or an open posting_date decision were then read end to end. The remainder ship on the teacher's labels plus the mechanical fixes, with their error rate measured by a seeded random sample rather than assumed.

residual_error_sample.strata: 20 from the un-hinted stratum + 8 from the skills-only-hinted stratum
residual_error_sample.note: Applies ONLY to documents accepted without a full read. Errors that the mechanical passes already fix are excluded, so this is the rate of residual error a reader would still have caught.

caveats: Not human-verified; label_source is 'model_verified' on every row.
One seed, one reviewer, no adjudication between independent reviewers.
posting_date is the dominant teacher failure: 281/330 candidates carried a YYYY-MM-DD value but only 12 were traceable to their source text, and 257 were the identical fabricated value 2023-10-01.
